topic: Silent-Ignore Cohort scoreboard — verification of c2 H1+H2+H5 self-applied patches
our_argument_summary: Section 6.15 documents twelve dome predictions whose declared test windows closed with no result ever posted: the dome's scoreboard structurally records hits and never records misses. Independent assessment: nine standard_physics/recycled, two tacit_withdrawal, one falsified (PRED-073).

h1_seven_to_nine.evidence: Objection-3 rebuttal now reads 'nine restate standard physics or recycle standard-physics claims, two are tacit withdrawals, one is falsified on the dome's own rule' (data/sections.json:part6, 6.15 Anticipated objections). Grep for 'seven restate' returns nothing. Cross-checked against the table this run: 8 standard_physics + 1 recycled (PRED-090) = nine; tacit_withdrawal = PRED-105 + PRED-106 = two; falsified = PRED-073 = one; total twelve matches the headline 'Twelve dome predictions' and the tally footnote. No other pre-12 count found in the subsection.

h2_status_convention.evidence: All ten 14+-day-silent rows (PRED-087/088/111/085/077/090/081/106 + 072/084) plus PRED-105 now display dome_silent_terminal; PRED-073 stays dome_silent (8d). Cross-checked all 12 rows against data/predictions.json author_status this run — exact match, single convention throughout. Standardization prose converted to past tense: 'Ten entries ... have been moved from pending to dome_silent_terminal'; the old 'are recommended to move' phrasing is absent (grep-verified).

h5_dangling_column_name.evidence: Explanatory sentence now reads 'Status (author-side, reconstructed) is the author-side posture in the dome's own record (or our reconstruction of it where the dome leaves the entry untouched)' — matches the renamed table header verbatim. Stale 'Dome status' phrase absent from the subsection (grep-verified).

dome_code_analysis.calculation_pipeline: Section-level review — no dome code claims changed by these patches. The section's claims are bookkeeping observations about the dome's predictions page, cross-checked against our predictions.json catalog.

holes_found.description: CARRY-OVER (c1 H3 / c2 H3 / ISS-2676, still open): provenance of the zero-dome-posted-results claim remains inline for only PRED-073 and PRED-105; the eight 2026-04-30 rows plus 072/084 still assert dome silence without an inline last-checked date. Expected — this round patched H1/H2/H5 only — but the load-bearing zero is still partly inferred from our catalog rather than from a cited check of the dome page.
holes_found.recommendation: Per ISS-2676: add a one-line section-level provenance note ('dome predictions page last checked YYYY-MM-DD; no result posted for any listed ID') mirroring the PRED-073 confirmed-2026-06-05 pattern.

holes_found.description: CARRY-OVER (c1 H5 / c2 H4 / ISS-2686, still open) and aging: the table still mixes as-of dates — pre-existing rows show 39d/51d/8d (as-of 2026-06-08), the two new rows show 59d (as-of 2026-06-09), and as of today (2026-06-10) all figures are 1–2 days stale (41/53/10/60d). PRED-073 also crosses the section's own 14-day rule on 2026-06-14 (window closed 2026-05-31), at which point the dome_silent row, the fairness caveat, and the 'eleven closed windows even excluding PRED-073' sentence all need a coordinated update.
holes_found.recommendation: Per ISS-2686: single as-of date for the whole table, all rows recomputed to it. Note the upcoming 2026-06-14 PRED-073 threshold crossing as a known follow-up edit so the row status, fairness sentence, and eleven-of-twelve count are updated together.

kernel_of_truth.description: The section already grants the strongest defender point itself: silence is not scored as falsification (data/sections.json:part6, Objection-3: 'Correct, and we do not score silence as a falsification on its own'), and the fairness caveat for PRED-073 plus the 'eleven closed windows even excluding PRED-073' sentence keep the cohort claim honest at the margin.
kernel_of_truth.why_it_doesnt_save_claim: The bookkeeping asymmetry stands independent of any single row: twelve closed windows, zero posted results, while the headline WIN tally grew over the same period (data/sections.json:part6, tally footnote) — a scoreboard that only increments wins is the finding, and the patched table now states it with one consistent status convention.

summary_for_decider: All three patched holes (ISS-2684 seven→nine; ISS-2685 status convention + tense; c2 H5 column-name sentence) verified landed cleanly; full 12-row cross-check against predictions.json passes; tally 9+2+1=12 consistent everywhere in the subsection. Two carry-overs remain open as expected and are restated with structured unresolved_prior_cycle entries: ISS-2676 (provenance, moderate) and ISS-2686 (mixed as-of dates, minor — dates now 1–2 days staler, and PRED-073 crosses the 14-day rule on 2026-06-14, requiring a coordinated touch of the row, the fairness sentence, and the eleven-of-twelve count). No new holes introduced by the patches.
deeper_analysis: Verification scope per queue class. The one substantive judgment call this pass: c2 H2 flagged mixed conventions; the decider resolved it by standardizing ALL 14+-day rows to dome_silent_terminal and rewriting the prose to past tense with an explicit ten-entry enumeration and an explicit rationale for reconciling 'silent_ignore_confirmed' onto the existing dome_silent_terminal value rather than adding a fourth silence status. That paragraph is now stronger than what c2 asked for — it pre-empts the 'you invented a status to inflate the count' defense. Checked for over-reach in the other direction: the standardization is clearly labeled as OUR reconstruction ('reconstructed' in the header, 'To keep our own catalog honest' in prose), so a defender cannot claim we misrepresent the dome's own page as marking these terminal.
